class.name: GraphDebugLink
class.brief_description: The editor's end of the debug channel to a running game.
class.description: Listens on the loopback address for a game that was started with [code]--remote-debug[/code] set to the address of the link, such as [code]tcp://127.0.0.1:6007[/code]. The link keeps what the game last said as one state, and sends the game commands. One game is attached at a time, and a game that connects while another is attached replaces it. Call [method poll] often. Read the state with [method get_state].

method.name: get_port
method.description: Returns the port the game connects to, or [code]0[/code] when the link does not listen.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns what the game last said, as JSON text. The keys are [code]connected[/code], [code]stopped[/code], [code]reason[/code], [code]stack[/code], [code]level[/code], [code]locals[/code], [code]members[/code] and [code]wire[/code]. [code]stack[/code] lists objects with [code]source[/code], [code]line[/code] and [code]function[/code], innermost first. For a graph script the [code]source[/code] is the script path and the function joined by [code]#[/code], and the [code]line[/code] is the step number. [code]locals[/code] and [code]members[/code] list objects with [code]name[/code] and [code]value[/code] for [code]level[/code]. [code]wire[/code] is an empty object until [method request_wire] is answered, then it holds [code]level[/code], [code]step[/code], [code]port[/code] and [code]value[/code]. The state is cleared when the game goes away or runs on.

method.name: listen
method.description: Starts listening on the loopback address. Port [code]0[/code] lets the system pick one, and [method get_port] says which. Returns an [enum Error] code.

method.name: poll
method.description: Takes in what the game said since the last call, and accepts a game that is waiting to connect.

method.name: request_variables
method.description: Asks the game for the locals and members of [param level] of the stack, the innermost level first. The reply replaces the ones in the state.

method.name: request_wire
method.description: Asks the game for the value on input [param port] of [param step] at [param level] of the stack. The reply sets [code]wire[/code] in the state. It is empty when the step has not run or the input is not there.

method.name: send_command
method.description: Sends [code]"step"[/code], [code]"next"[/code], [code]"out"[/code], [code]"continue"[/code] or [code]"break"[/code]. Step goes into a call, next goes over it and out leaves it. Break stops a game that is running. Any other text prints an error and sends nothing.

method.name: set_breakpoint
method.description: Sets or clears a breakpoint on [param step] of [param source], which is a script path and a function joined by [code]#[/code].
